response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) * 1.0 AS total FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count_above, AVG(c.cnt / s.total) AS avg_fraction_of_total, AVG(c.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c, s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt
